hints: To change a decimal to a percent, multiply by 100.
Multiplying by 100 moves the decimal point two places to the right.
Move the point in 0.07 two places right, then add the % sign.

solution.methodName: Decimal to percent: move the point two places right

steps.action: Multiply by 100 by moving the point two places right.
steps.why: Percent means out of 100, so the percent is 100 times the decimal.

steps.action: Move it one place: 0.07 → 0.7. Move it again: 0.7 → 7.

trapNotes.70%: 70% = 0.70. The 7 in 0.07 is in the hundredths place, so it is 7 out of 100.
trapNotes.0.07%: This adds the % sign without multiplying by 100. 0.07% is 100 times smaller than 0.07.
trapNotes.0.7%: This moves the point only one place. To change a decimal to a percent, move it two places.
